summary: Local ice fisherman fell between two breaking shoreline ice sheets on Blue Mesa Reservoir near the Lake City Bridge; evacuated from the ice by Gunnison Fire and EMS with help of NPS Curecanti rangers; injuries of unknown extent.
location: Blue Mesa Reservoir, shoreline ice near Lake City Bridge
responding_agency: Gunnison Fire and EMS; NPS Curecanti National Recreation Area rangers
notes: CBN 2021-03-24: incident Friday 3/19 per article; corroborated by NPS CURE pr21-02 release 2021-03-22 (changing ice conditions); first new CURE-line row since run 532-era coverage gap in thin year 2021
